purpose: Howard asked whether commercial consumer devices can reach the ultrasonic speaker frequencies being discussed. This extends the earlier JBL/Mackie/Pebble comparison with new candidates, without changing historical budgets.
evidence_scope: Published manufacturer claims and displayed prices; no bench validation, delivered quotation, purchase or vendor contact.

observed_price.package: Powered speaker pair: one active, one passive companion
observed_price.availability: In stock, ready to ship displayed on retrieved US product page; unreserved
observed_price.exclusions: Tax, shipping and any source-specific connections

candidates.amplification: Built in, 18W+18W nominal. No separate SA1 is assumed required for this candidate.
candidates.connections: Balanced analog TRS, RCA and 3.5 mm AUX; Bluetooth is also supported. Candidate experimental evaluation should use a wired input and measure the complete signal path.
candidates.processing: Manufacturer describes 24bit/96kHz analog frontend and Class-D amplifier configuration. Manual specifies output power with DRC on and includes monitor/music/custom modes, EQ, room tuning and firmware updates. Short-pip envelope, level dependence and latency are unmeasured.
candidates.interpretation: Nominal range encompasses 1.4-32kHz, making this a lower-cost candidate to test for the paper's tone band. The retrieved specs provide no numeric +/-dB tolerance, ultrasonic output-level/distortion curve or acoustic onset bound.
candidates.measurement_dependency: A microphone and acquisition chain validated above20kHz are still needed; the basic EMM-6 does not establish 32kHz measurements. Check actual source-to-speaker path bandwidth rather than inferring it from a DAC sample rate.

candidates.source_location: Sony January2026 component catalog, PDFpage4, printedpages6-7, SS-CS5M2 column

observed_price.availability: Fresh US store price observed; stock and delivery not reserved
observed_price.exclusions: Compatible amplifier, cables, tax and shipping

candidates.price_limit: Search caches show a199.99USD sale; fresh directstore observation is279.99USD. Do not substitute cached promotion for a confirmed current price.
candidates.amplification: Separate compatible power amplifier required; rated impedance6ohms. An amplifier's actual ultrasonic bandwidth must be checked.
candidates.interpretation: The M2 frequency range is verified from its own catalog column, rather than inherited from the older SS-CS5. No 32kHz at-ear level, distortion or short-tone performance has been verified.

observed_price.package: Shop listing; main product page describes pairs, but exact chosen shop package and delivered US cost remain unconfirmed
observed_price.exclusions: Compatible amplifier/system, delivery and tax/import charges where additional

candidates.amplification: Passive ribbon add-on, normally connected to an already amplified speaker output. It is not a complete powered broadband speaker.
candidates.interpretation: A commercial hi-fi example with a claimed band reaching65-90kHz. Its high-frequency-only band cannot cover the full1.4-32kHz stimulus set on its own. Manufacturer response and timing claims are not experimental verification.
candidates.source_limit: Only the stated technical response, connection and price information is used. Marketing claims about ultrasonic hearing, neurological benefits, cryogenic cables or sound quality are not adopted as scientific evidence.

additional_screening.note: Powered consumer example, but MR3 is the lower-cost candidate identified. US price was not selected as a main purchasing recommendation.

Commercial40kHz transmitters are examples of producing ultrasound, but a nominal resonant frequency does not establish broadband reproduction of the randomized tone set. Not selected as a direct speaker substitute.

decision_scope: Consumer products should not be excluded solely because TDT research speakers were in the earlier comparison. MR3 is a promising lower-cost 32kHz-band candidate for measured wired bench evaluation; selection requires frequency-by-frequency level/distortion, actual10ms-pip waveform, latency/jitter and recorder alignment checks. These are not completed results.
actions: Research and dated source documentation only. No purchase, message, vendor contact, hardware connection or animal/bench experiment. Earlier PDFs, price records and website source are unchanged.
